Through your network participation with GEHA Connection Dental Network, you are considered in 
network with HRI Dental (previously known as Paramount Dental).   HRI Dental works directly with 
Select Health and administers the  Dental plan for their  Medicare Advantage members.   
 
We are reaching out to inform you of an important change to Select Health dental benefits in 2025. The only plan that will continue offering implant coverage in 2025 is Select Medicare Essential plan in 
Nevada (Paramount/HRI group ID G00D0022NV12; Select group ID G00D0026). All other Select 
Medicare plans will discontinue implant coverage as of 1/1/25.  
 Due to the confusion of their health and dental plan names  in 2024, Select  Health has also removed the 
HMO from their dental plan names .   The Medicare Advantage dental plans utilize preferred provider 
networks.    
Please feel free to reach out to HRI Dental at 1-833-203-1176 with any questions you may have 
regarding the changes for 2025.
